《巴宰語詞典》p.178，madu 條下派生詞

senses.en: to lay a snare to catch wild animals
seeds of rattan, which tastes sour
to show the teeth by being burnt (of animals)
to reduce the price, to bargain
to go down (as of swelling water), to shrink, to be def lated, to decrease
acrid, itchy in taste (as the stem if taro), acrid
to dance and sing hand in hand
to marry someone from the same age group, remated relatives

notes: 原書 remated，疑為 related 之誤，照抄不改
